entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It may be a Sunday, but that[n]time of relaxation is ruined[n]by all of the noise outside.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yup. No matter where I go, I[n]keep hearing election speeches.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'd be fine if that was all...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Shido's calling himself a[n]brave hero who stood up to[n]vile terrorists.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't make me laugh. He's[n]nothing but rotten scum.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It seems he's been using the[n]Phantom Thieves as ammunition[n]for his political activities.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And it's been exactly two[n]weeks since the news of[n][fName]'s suicide.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He'll probably be killed if[n]they learn he's still alive.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName]'s safety is vital.[n]We will hold back nothing[n]in order to help out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we work together, I know[n]we can pull this off!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Just give the word when you're[n]ready and we'll all come over!
